where.if: AND ( p.problem_number ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.title, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.region, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(ps.label, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM problem_tags kpt JOIN tags kt ON kt.id=kpt.tag_id WHERE kpt.problem_id=p.id AND kt.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.problem_number, p.title, p.year, p.region, p.source_code, ps.label AS source_label, p.question_type, p.difficulty, p.content, p.content_format, p.creator_user_id, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM problems p LEFT JOIN problem_sources ps ON ps.code=p.source_code
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id DESC ORDER BY p.favorite_count DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY CASE p.difficulty WHEN 'white' THEN 1 WHEN 'green' THEN 2 WHEN 'cyan' THEN 3 WHEN 'blue' THEN 4 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 5 WHEN 'orange' THEN 6 WHEN 'red' THEN 7 WHEN 'purple' THEN 8 WHEN 'black' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END ASC, p.id ASC
ORDER BY CASE p.difficulty WHEN 'black' THEN 1 WHEN 'purple' THEN 2 WHEN 'red' THEN 3 WHEN 'orange' THEN 4 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 5 WHEN 'blue' THEN 6 WHEN 'cyan' THEN 7 WHEN 'green' THEN 8 WHEN 'white' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END ASC, p.id ASC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM problems p LEFT JOIN problem_sources ps ON ps.code=p.source_code
